text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 30, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "time", "span": "it took her 30 minutes to cook rice"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 20, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "time", "span": "20 more minutes to cook pork than rice"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "beans took half the combined cooking time of pork and rice"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "pork takes the rice time plus 20 minutes"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "combined cooking time of pork and rice"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "beans take half of that"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "rice, pork and beans together"}], "target": {"kind": "time", "scope": "the total minutes to cook all the food"}, "dismissed": []}
